results.content: # Replicability and reproducibility of data-intensive design research using workflows - example in facial expression synchrony as a measure of empathy. We present a step-by-step guide to applying a data analysis workflow in design research using an example of measuring empathic understanding via facial expression analysis. We describe the steps of data-intensive research workflow and demonstrate it using an example of using facial recognition data to measure user-designer empathy in video-recorded remote interviews. This section introduces a design research project that exemplifies the application of a data science workflow in studying user-designer empathy through facial expression synchrony (Salmi, Li, and Holtta-Otto Citation2023).
